adjudication.rationale: In the migration `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb`, hosts are inserted via raw SQL with string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"`. If any `h` contains a single quote (or other SQL-special chars), the SQL becomes invalid and the migration can fail (and it also creates an injection vector from stored settings data). This is a verifiable defect in the diff.
